checklist.item: Is the claim one for which a formal notice (الإعذار) is a precondition of damages for delay, or of the claim itself?
checklist.note: Damages, performance and rescission follow the notice.

checklist.item: Was a formal notice actually sent to the defendant before filing, and is there proof of it?
On what date was the notice served, and did the defendant receive it (acknowledgement of receipt)?
checklist.note: No text fixes how the date is proved; the slot notice_date is kept by the app and not read by a rule.

checklist.item: By what means was it sent: bailiff, registered letter with acknowledgement of receipt, or another means; which means does the law accept?
Does the notice clearly call on the debtor to perform, and does it fix a reasonable period to comply?
checklist.note: No text in the store on the content of a notice or on a period to comply; searched articles on default in the Civil Code, Commercial Code and Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure.

checklist.item: Is the notice addressed to the right person, at the right address, and in the right capacity (debtor, heir, representative)?
checklist.note: Nothing on addressee or capacity; the postal provision referred to by art. 180 was requested.

checklist.item: Does the contract itself state that the debtor is in default by the mere passing of the term, without notice?
Is the obligation one with a fixed term, so that default arises by the term itself?
Is the notice unnecessary because performance has become impossible or useless through the debtor's act?
Is the notice unnecessary because the debtor has declared in writing that he will not perform?
Is the notice unnecessary for a debt of money arising from a wrongful act, or for restitution of something taken without right?
Is the notice unnecessary for a debt of something received without right, with bad faith of the recipient?
Is the notice unnecessary in a case where the law itself provides that default is automatic?
checklist.note: Art. 179 yields to a contrary text; art. 392 is one.

checklist.item: What is the effect of the absence of a notice: inadmissibility of the claim, or only refusal of damages for delay?
From what date do damages for delay and legal interest run: from the notice, from the filing, or from the term?
Does the claim itself (the filing of the petition) stand in place of a notice for any request?
checklist.note: No text says the filing replaces the notice; see o3.

checklist.item: In commercial matters, is a notice needed, and does the form differ?
checklist.note: Searched Commercial Code for notice: only the lease articles.

checklist.item: Does a notice to quit or a notice to pay in a lease follow a separate regime (see the commercial lease module)?
Can the notice be replaced by a conciliation step or a prior formal summons required for the particular claim?
Does the notice interrupt a limitation period or only place the debtor in default?
checklist.note: No article makes the notice a cause of interruption; see the periods module.

checklist.item: Is a notice needed before rescission of a contract for non-performance, and may the judge grant a period of grace?
Can the lawyer keep a copy of the notice and of the receipt in the file as documents to annex to the petition?
Is the notice valid if sent by a means not accepted by law, and can the court still treat it as notice?
Must the notice be in Arabic, and signed by whom?
checklist.note: No text on language or signature of the notice.

checklist.item: Is a fresh notice needed when the amount or the obligation changed after the first notice?
checklist.note: No text on a fresh notice after a change.

checklist.item: In joint or indivisible obligations, to whom must the notice go?
checklist.note: No text on joint or indivisible obligations in the store; searched the Civil Code on default.

checklist.item: Is a notice needed against a public body, and does a different prior step apply?
checklist.note: The administrative-procedure notices of the CPCA are court acts inside a case, not a step before a claim.

checklist.item: What must the petition say about the notice (date, means, result) so that the court can check it?
What the store's note on art. 119 raises: the text is a current snapshot, the historical regimes are deferred.
checklist.note: The record follows the text in force; no amendment of the article was found in the store.

says.ar: لا يستحق التعويض إلا بعد إعذار المدين ما لم يوجد نص مخالف.
says.en: Damages are due only after the debtor is put in default, unless a text says otherwise.

says.ar: يكون الإعذار بإنذار أو بما يقوم مقامه أو عن طريق البريد، أو باتفاق يجعل المدين معذرا بحلول الأجل دون إجراء آخر.
says.en: Default is created by a notice or an equivalent act, by post, or by an agreement that the debtor is in default when the term falls due.

says.ar: لا حاجة إلى الإعذار إذا تعذر التنفيذ أو صار غير مجد بفعل المدين.
says.en: No notice is needed where the debtor's own act made performance impossible or pointless.

says.ar: لا حاجة إلى الإعذار إذا كان محل الالتزام تعويضا عن عمل مضر.
says.en: No notice is needed where the obligation is compensation for a harmful act.

says.ar: لا حاجة إلى الإعذار في رد شيء يعلم المدين أنه مسروق أو تسلمه دون حق وهو عالم بذلك.
says.en: No notice is needed to recover a thing the debtor knows to be stolen or knowingly received without right.

says.ar: لا حاجة إلى الإعذار إذا صرح المدين كتابة بأنه لا ينوى تنفيذ التزامه.
says.en: No notice is needed where the debtor states in writing that he does not intend to perform.

says.ar: في العقد الملزم للجانبين يسبق طلبَ التنفيذ أو الفسخ إعذارُ المدين.
says.en: In a bilateral contract, the creditor asks for performance or rescission after putting the debtor in default.

says.ar: للقاضي أن يمنح المدين أجلا وأن يرفض الفسخ إذا كان ما لم يوف به قليل الأهمية.
says.en: The judge may give the debtor time, and may refuse rescission if the unperformed part is of little importance.

says.ar: شرط الفسخ بحكم القانون لا يعفي من الإعذار، ويحدد أجله حسب العرف عند عدم تحديده.
says.en: A clause of automatic rescission does not remove the notice; its period follows custom if the parties fixed none.

says.ar: يجبر المدين بعد إعذاره على التنفيذ العيني متى كان ممكنا.
says.en: The debtor is compelled to perform in kind, if possible, after being put in default.

says.ar: يحكم بالتعويض عن عدم التنفيذ أو عن التأخر في التنفيذ.
says.en: Damages are awarded for non-performance, and also for delay in performance.

says.ar: إذا كان محل الالتزام مبلغا من النقود عين مقداره وقت رفع الدعوى وتأخر المدين، عوض الدائن عن ضرر التأخير.
says.en: For a sum of money fixed at the time of filing, the debtor who delays compensates the creditor for the harm of delay.

says.ar: التعويض المتفق عليه مسبقا تطبق عليه أحكام المواد المتعلقة بالإعذار.
says.en: Agreed compensation is subject to the rules on default and notice.

says.ar: في بيع المنقولات بأجل لدفع الثمن يفسخ البيع وجوبا دون سابق إنذار عند حلول الأجل ما لم يتفق على خلافه.
says.en: In a sale of movables with a term for the price, the sale is rescinded without prior notice when the term falls due, unless agreed otherwise.

says.ar: يسبق مطالبة المستأجر بالفسخ أو بإنقاص الإيجار لعدم الصيانة إعذار المؤجر بمحرر غير قضائي.
says.en: A tenant claims rescission or a rent reduction for lack of upkeep only after notice to the lessor by a non-judicial instrument.

says.ar: رفض رب العمل التسلم بعد دعوته بإنذار رسمي يجعل العمل مسلما إليه.
says.en: An owner who refuses delivery after an official notice is treated as having received the work.

says.ar: إنذار المؤجر بالمخالفة يكون بعقد غير قضائي مع بيان السبب وإلا بطل.
says.en: A notice to a tenant of a breach must be by a non-judicial act stating the reason, or it is void.

says.ar: يجوز تقديم طلب توجيه إنذار إلى رئيس الجهة القضائية المختصة.
says.en: A request to have a notice issued may be presented to the president of the competent court.

basis.interpretiveNote: The article regulates the president's order; that such a notice counts as formal notice under the Civil Code is a reading.

note.ar: اتفاق على أن المدين معذر بحلول الأجل.
note.en: Agreement that the debtor is in default at the term.
Performance made impossible by the debtor.

note.ar: رد شيء مسروق أو متسلم دون حق مع العلم.
note.en: Return of a thing stolen or knowingly received without right.

note.ar: فسخ بيع منقول بعدم دفع الثمن عند الأجل.
note.en: Rescission of a movable sale for unpaid price at the term.

label.en: Registered letter with acknowledgement of receipt (post)

label.ar: إنذار بأمر من رئيس الجهة القضائية
label.en: A notice ordered by the president of the court
An act equivalent to a notice

message.ar: المواد 179 و119 و164 من القانون المدني: لا يستحق التعويض ولا يطلب التنفيذ أو الفسخ إلا بعد إعذار المدين، وتستثنى الحالات المبينة في المادة 181 والمادة 180 والمادة 392. تحقق من وجود الإعذار أو من انطباق إحدى الاستثناءات.
message.en: Civil Code arts. 179, 119 and 164: damages, performance or rescission follow a notice to the debtor, subject to the cases of art. 181, art. 180 and art. 392. Check that a notice was sent or that an exception applies.

priorSteps.interpretiveNote: The texts make damages, performance and rescission follow the notice but state no sanction on the claim itself; the means named are a reading of the words 'notice or what stands in its place' and of the postal route.

message.ar: المادة 180 من القانون المدني: يكون الإعذار بإنذار أو بما يقوم مقامه أو عن طريق البريد؛ تحقق من أن الوسيلة الأخرى المستعملة تقوم مقام الإنذار.
message.en: Civil Code art. 180: default arises by a notice, an equivalent act or by post; check that the other means used stands in place of a notice.

priorSteps.interpretiveNote: The text does not list the equivalent acts; the lawyer must judge whether the means used is one.

why.en: To prove the notice, its date and its content.

name.en: Bailiff's record or acknowledgement of receipt

why.en: To prove the notice reached the debtor.

name.ar: بند الاتفاق على الإعذار بحلول الأجل
name.en: The clause making the debtor in default at the term

why.en: The exemption from notice rests on it.
The exemption from notice rests on it.

looksLike.en: A notice to a commercial tenant or landlord

tellingFacts.ar: إنذار بعقد غير قضائي مع بيان السبب.
tellingFacts.en: A non-judicial act stating the reason.

message.ar: المادة 177 من القانون التجاري: إنذار المؤجر بمخالفة المستأجر يخضع لشكل خاص؛ راجع وحدة الإيجار التجاري.
message.en: Commercial Code art. 177: a notice of a tenant's breach follows its own form; see the commercial-lease module.

looksLike.en: A record of non-conciliation in a labour dispute

tellingFacts.ar: يحرره مكتب المصالحة ولا يوجه إلى المدين لإعذاره.
tellingFacts.en: Drawn up by the conciliation office, not sent to the debtor to put him in default.

message.ar: محضر عدم المصالحة ليس إعذارا بمعنى المادة 180 من القانون المدني؛ راجع وحدة المصالحة العمالية.
message.en: A record of non-conciliation is not a notice under Civil Code art. 180; see the labour-conciliation module.

looksLike.en: A notice to a lessor for failure of upkeep

message.ar: المادة 480 من القانون المدني: إعذار المؤجر بعدم الصيانة يكون بمحرر غير قضائي؛ تحقق من الشكل.
message.en: Civil Code art. 480: notice to a lessor for lack of upkeep is by a non-judicial instrument; check the form.

looksLike.ar: دعوة رب العمل إلى تسلم العمل
looksLike.en: A call on the owner to take delivery of work

tellingFacts.ar: إنذار رسمي يرتب اعتبار العمل مسلما.
tellingFacts.en: An official notice that makes the work treated as delivered.

message.ar: المادة 558 من القانون المدني: الإنذار الرسمي لرب العمل يرتب اعتبار العمل مسلما؛ راجع شكله.
message.en: Civil Code art. 558: an official notice to the owner makes the work treated as delivered; check its form.
